title: I his mute orderly
html_source:
J.F. Byrne, upon whom Cranly was based was a reticent friend of Joyce who never proffered an opinion on Joyce’s antics.

JF. Byrne is in the middle of Joyce,right and George clancy,left : Ellmann (via http://cas.umt.edu/english/joyce/notes/010060cranlysarm.htm).

Father who art in purgatory. Khaki Hamlets don't hesitate to shoot. The bloodboltered shambles in act five is a forecast of the concentration camp sung by Mr Swinburne. 

 Cranly,
anchor.suffix:
, following battles from afar. 

Whelps and dams of murderous foes whom none
But we had spared... 

 Between the Saxon smile and yankee yawp. The devil and the deep sea.
